about_the_game:
\The border never sleeps, and neither do the criminals. 🌃 Step into the shoes of a Customs Officer and take on the most difficult border patrol cases after sundown in this intense police simulator! 🕵️‍♀️

The rules of the day don't apply at night. Use your new night-exclusive mechanics to outsmart smugglers and protect the nation. Every choice matters more under the cover of darkness. 🚨

NEW NIGHT SHIFT FEATURES:

🔦 Forgery Detection Kit: Use special UV lights and watermark revealers to uncover hidden passport forgeries that are invisible to the naked eye.

🔋 Rechargeable Flashlight: Navigate the dark and search vehicles with your trusty flashlight, but manage its battery wisely to avoid being left in the dark.

🌡️ Mistake Thermometer: A brand-new feature that tracks your precision and mistakes. Keep your error rate low to earn a higher rank and secure your promotion!

🗣️ Event with Dialog Options: Engage in interactive conversations and make critical choices that shape the narrative of your night shift.

📻 Radio Calls: Receive urgent intel and new orders from headquarters via your radio, keeping you on the edge of your seat.

🤫 Scratcher: A powerful tool that can reveal hidden information on documents, but be careful—it could damage them if used incorrectly!

🌟 VIP Bus Arrivals: Manage the occasional arrival of high-profile diplomats or celebrities, requiring you to follow special protocols and ensure their safety.

This isn't just another day at the office—it's a high-stakes night shift job simulator where one mistake could mean the difference between peace and chaos. Are you ready to face the pressure and become the ultimate night border hero?

Download Black Border 2: Night Shift today and prove your skills when the sun goes down! 🌌
